outputIntent: Prove a sequence of change across separately validated states while preserving one base identity, camera, light, scale, and background.
positioning: Not a mood collage or one-call multi-panel fantasy; it is an evidence contact sheet assembled from identity-locked state assets.
contentSchema: locked camera lens distance crop and background

layoutFamilies.topology: two or four equal cells share identical subject bounding boxes, horizons, gutters, and color grade; no cell receives decorative emphasis
layoutFamilies.readingPath: state one -> state two -> state three -> state four
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: identical camera and subject scale across separately generated state references
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: two to four validated state cells and uniform gutters

layoutFamilies.topology: three to six ordered frames run on one disciplined axis with identical crop and a single visible state variable changing step by step
layoutFamilies.readingPath: earliest state -> intermediate states -> final state
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: locked lens viewpoint horizon crop and key-light direction across every source frame
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: three to six separately validated states assembled deterministically

physicalVisualSystem.material: consistent editorial photography or one consistent illustration medium selected for the run; clean contact-sheet paper and thin gutters
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: one locked key-light direction size softness fill and background tone across all states
physicalVisualSystem.color: one unified grade with fixed white balance contrast and saturation; only the allowed state variable changes color
physicalVisualSystem.typography: no generated text by default; state labels, if needed, are deterministic outside the image cells

allowedVariations: state-specific surface moisture or wear only when supplied
qcAssertions: every state asset passes identity comparison before assembly
subject bounding box and camera remain matched
the final row and all cells remain above the subtitle-safe band
